meaning: Manually audited implementation coverage, not native conformance or runtime admission. Source changes require a new audit.

TURN.note: Interpreter turn/every selector; full native scheduling not established.

TURNINTERVAL.note: Current absolute modulo timing is not full last-activation semantics.

RANDOMTURN.note: Current supplied roll/turn hook; full native scheduling not claimed.

SCENARIOLOADED.note: Interpreter recognition is not complete native startup/session delivery.

NEGOTIATION.note: Interpreter matching is not an implemented diplomatic conversation/hook.

CHANGEMONEY.note: Current treasury effect; supported receiver contexts only.

CREATEUNIT.note: First-valid placement; native validity, randomize and map contexts remain partial.

GIVETECHNOLOGY.note: events.rs emits it; effects.rs returns Applied::Skipped. Research elsewhere does not implement this action.

JUSTONCE.note: In-memory event latch; native imported event state is not restored.

TEXT.note: Effect/log recording is not full scenario client delivery.

PLAYCDTRACK.note: Recorded effect; no native track playback claim.

DONTPLAYWONDERS.note: Applied::NoState; native presentation semantics are not implemented.

global_limits: Native SAV/SCN human-session import is not implemented.

Keyword recognition cannot admit simulation, observation, human campaigns or native export.
